glossary.definition: (1) "Veterinarian" means an individual licensed under Chapter 4741. of the Revised Code to practice veterinary medicine.
glossary.source_title: Section 4765.52 - Emergency medical attention to dog or cat.

glossary.definition: (2) "Police dog" has the same meaning as in section 2921.321 of the Revised Code.
